messages:
devon: Quick question — I'm planning a migration for order-service and payment-service from ExternalSecrets to the Vault Agent injector (dynamic tokens) so we don't keep static k8s Secrets around. Sketch below; want a rollout plan + TF patch review. TL;DR: add vault annotations + serviceAccount role, keep ExternalSecrets in place during canary.

sam: Sounds good. A couple of clarifying q's: 1) are we planning per-service Vault roles or a shared role? 2) how do we author the Terraform change (k8s_service_account + manifest vs kubernetes_manifest)? :eyes:

olivia: I recommend per-service roles for least privilege. TF-wise we usually do: create a kubernetes_service_account resource, then kubernetes_manifest for the annot patch so we don't re-render entire deployment. Example snippet: 
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "order_sa" {
  metadata {
    name      = "order-service-sa"
    namespace = "prod"
    annotations = {
      "vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject" = "true"
      "vault.hashicorp.com/role"         = "order-role"
    }
  }
}
```
We also add a ConfigMap for vault-agent config and give the SA the IAM role that Vault uses (if cloud auth).

patrick: Rollout idea: keep ExternalSecrets syncing current secret into k8s for a week while we enable agent injector on a small subset (canary namespace). After validating token issuance + app behavior, flip traffic 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 days. Monitor logs + metrics: vault.agent.inject.success, vault.tokens.issued, app errors. If anything spikes, revert by removing annotation and keep ExternalSecrets. :shipit:

devon: For rotation TTL: we'll request short TTL (1h) with auto-renew for long-lived workflows; for cron workers maybe use one-off tokens. Need a policy per role: minimal read for secret path `secret/data/order/*`. We'll also add an audit entry in Console when a role is created.

marisol: I can take the TF/manifest diff once you post it. Also we should add a step to update the cluster rolebinding that allows the injector webhook to mount the init container.

devon: Example kubectl command to annotate an existing deployment for a manual smoke-run: 
```bash
kubectl annotate deploy/order-service -n prod \ \
  vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject=true \ \
  vault.hashicorp.com/role=order-role --overwrite
```
Run `kubectl rollout restart deploy/order-service -n prod` after annotation.

sam: What about fallback if Vault is unavailable? Can the app read from a secret sync cache or fall back to ExternalSecrets? We should have a fallback path.

olivia: Yes, plan is: keep ExternalSecrets syncing to a `*-legacy` secret name. Injector will mount as files and apps should prefer files if present; fallback code path reads `legacy` secret if mount missing. We'll also add a small feature flag to apps to prefer injector.

infra-bot: CI: infra/terraform PR #1234 passed plan & lint checks — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1234 :white_check_mark:

devon: Great — Marisol will do the PR review. @sam can you own the RBAC/rolebinding change? I'll open a doc with the rollout checklist and link it here. Thanks everyone :pray:
